question: 107 条记录里，落盘 value 与公开公式重算完全相等的有多少条（即数据漂移检出的不一致条数为 107 减此值）？
verify:
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = next(p for p in map(Path, sys.path) if (p / "portfolio-mcp" / "data" / "repos.json").is_file())
DATA = ROOT / "portfolio-mcp" / "data"
repos = json.loads((DATA / "repos.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
W = {"evidence": 0.3, "boundary": 0.2, "entry": 0.2, "original": 0.2, "maintain": 0.1}
rc = lambda v: round(sum(W[k] * (v.get(k) or 0) for k in W) * 10 * 100) / 100
result = sum(1 for r in repos if rc(r["v"]) == r["value"])

question: 从 server.mjs 源码里解析 WEIGHTS 常量的五个权重并求和，得到的和是多少（权重必须归一到 1）？
verify:
import re, sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = next(p for p in map(Path, sys.path) if (p / "portfolio-mcp" / "data" / "repos.json").is_file())
src = (ROOT / "portfolio-mcp" / "server.mjs").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
block = re.search(r"WEIGHTS\s*=\s*\{([^}]*)\}", src).group(1)
vals = [float(x) for x in re.findall(r":\s*([0-9.]+)", block)]
result = round(sum(vals), 10)

question: board.json 的 medianValue（6.16）是否等于 90 条 original 仓库 value 的中位数？是则返回 true。
verify:
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = next(p for p in map(Path, sys.path) if (p / "portfolio-mcp" / "data" / "repos.json").is_file())
DATA = ROOT / "portfolio-mcp" / "data"
repos = json.loads((DATA / "repos.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
board = json.loads((DATA / "board.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
vals = sorted(r["value"] for r in repos if r.get("cat") == "original")
n = len(vals)
med = vals[n // 2] if n % 2 else (vals[n // 2 - 1] + vals[n // 2]) / 2
result = round(med, 2) == round(board["medianValue"], 2)
